about: The VM's budgets (tools/bench/vm_bench --check; tools/regress.sh perf). Times: the fastest of the runs' CPU time (start-up: wall time); a budget missed fails. "budgets" were measured on an Apple-silicon Mac (busy with other builds), "systems" holds a system's own (by platform.system()). Measured 2026-10-15 (DEBUG-VM) — the Mac before: start-up 10.5 ms, the 10 M loop 1088 ms (1624 ms under the debugger), strings 1284 ms, Fib(27) 94 ms, arrays 552 ms, Studio running an idle program 10.2 % CPU; after: 8 ms, 607 ms (717 ms), 566 ms, 59 ms, 338 ms, 0.25 %. Ubuntu 24.04 (ARM, in a VM) on one core and 2 GB: 2.4 ms, 1285 ms (1332 ms), 481 ms, 93 ms, 759 ms, idle 0 %, Studio running it 0.25 %, Studio's start 261 ms.
